function: no_learning: subcarrier split between sensing and communication is closed-form (p. 4, eqs. 10, 12, Alg. 1); the PPO agent only sets the AGV force and an accuracy target (p. 3).
notes: The PDF is arXiv 2409.08005v1, with the same title and five authors as the Crossref record of the DOI (IEEE TVT 74(5), 8413-8418). Exclusion: no learned component performs the physical-layer function. p. 3: '(i) an uncertainty control RL algorithm is utilized to devise control actions for the physical world' and '(ii) Subcarrier optimization algorithm is applied to identify suitable {ns,t, nc,t}, guided by the requirements of the RL model and DT'. p. 3: the PPO action 'at = [at, ηt], comprises control signals at that affect the environment and ηt for accuracy in estimated position', for the 'Mountain-Car Continuous problem' (p. 1). p. 4: nc,t 'is obtained in closed-form by definition' (eq. 10) and 'the closed-form lower bound of ns,t' (eq. 12), applied by the if-else rules of Alg. 1. p. 5: the compared schemes are two priority variants that 'also follow Alg. 1' and 'Equal', which 'allocates subcarriers equally for sensing and communication as N/2'. So the learned PPO is the controller of the AGV that the ISAC link serves, and the ISAC resource allocation is not learned. Borderline for the reviewer: the ηt chosen by PPO sets the accuracy target of the closed-form sensing allocation (p. 4, Section IV item (i)). If that is read as a learned resource decision, the work would be area 5 instead (AP with an R x C array, 28 GHz, pp. 2-4).
